name: lerevenu-community
description: Le Revenu community technical test: Next.js (apps/web) + Strapi v5 (apps/cms) + PostgreSQL

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/cms install && cd apps/web && bun install
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/cms test && cd apps/web && bun run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/cms run typecheck && cd apps/web && bun run typecheck
